workload.note: the case exactly as executed (testcase commit c4fe45173; identity.txt records the committed file's hash beside it)

seed_and_generator_version.note: fixed deterministic workload; no generator and no seed

session_and_barrier_trace.note: the case's ordered external operation journal: request and acknowledgement per transaction, crash, restart, observations, final outcome; single-session, so no participant barrier

engine_identity.note: baseline commit, install prefix, cubrid_rel and the sha256 of libcubrid.so, libcubridsa.so, cub_server and csql, verified against ticket 11 before the launcher started; CTP jar and init.sh hashes

testcase_identity.note: repository testcases-private-ex, branch, commit c4fe45173, base commit e9c2d8687

specification_identity.note: context revision and content hash, catalogue hash

build_and_configuration_identity.note: the CTP shell configuration used (scenario, no update, no retry, campaign ports); release build; the case's own createdb sets the 16384 B page size; install_conf_backup/ holds the pinned install's configuration as found

fixture_identity.note: the case's createdb output: database name, page size and volume options; fixture sizes are constants in workload.sh

expected_versus_actual.note: expected side from the oracle's ordered assertion table (18 rows), actual side the .result file, compared by number, status and full name; verdict MATCH

logs.note: the server's own error log for the case's database (recovery lines included); CTP runtime logs and the PTY transcript sit beside it

cores.note: no core file: a kill -9 produces none and the post-run scan found none

replay_command_with_prerequisites.note: the replay command and the prerequisites it does not create: pinned install and hashes, CTP, the testcase worktree at the recorded commit, the four free campaign ports, unprivileged user namespaces

uncommitted_snapshots.what: OOS-CONTEXT.md at the pinned content hash (uncommitted in the context repository at pin time, ticket 11 section 3)
